subject: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara.mills@orchidtx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff

Hi Sara — great to meet you briefly at AWS Summit last week. I’m Rishi on Redwood’s Marketplace & Partner GTM team. Per our conversation, Orchid sounds like a strong fit for an AWS co-sell path and marketplace listing, and we’d love to coordinate a short joint-account kickoff to align stakeholders and surface any procurement / legal blockers early.

High-level asks from our side so we can come prepared:
- List of stakeholders we should invite (sales, procurement, security/compliance) with emails
- Any timing constraints for procurement or fiscal approvals
- Quick pre-read on privacy/security posture (SOC2, data residency) or existing vendor questionnaire if you have one

Proposed next steps:
1) 30–45 min joint kickoff next week to map a mutual action plan and decide AWS PM handoff
2) Share a one-page mutual action plan draft that we can iterate on
3) Legal team preread on basic contract terms to identify redlines early (I’ll attach our redline guidance)

I’ve attached a short mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx and a redlines_guidance.docx for context. Can you share preferred times (Tue–Thu morning PT works for us) and primary contacts?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx
Attachment: redlines_guidance.docx

From: Sara Mills <sara.mills@orchidtx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@orchidtx.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@orchidtx.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff

Hi Rishi — thanks for following up and for the templates, this is helpful.

Quick context: I’m Sara (Head of Strategic Accounts at Orchid). I’ve looped in Tom (VP Sales) and Anika (Security & Compliance) — Anika will be the quickest to tell you what we need for SOC2/procurement.

Stakeholders to include:
- Tom Gallagher (VP Sales) — tom.gallagher@orchidtx.com
- Priya Desai (Procurement Lead) — priya.desai@orchidtx.com
- Anika Rao (Security) — anika.rao@orchidtx.com

We can do Wed, Jul 21 or Thu, Jul 22 between 9:00–11:30am PT. For the preread, I’ve uploaded a short account brief (orchid_account_brief.pdf) with product scope and expected consumption patterns — attaching here.

A few quick notes from Anika: we are SOC2 Type II in progress (expected completion Q3), we prefer to see vendor data retention and access controls up front. Also, our procurement team requires a SOW + master services agreement template for any marketplace deals.

I’ll leave it to you to pick a time; Priya will handle procurement timing once we align on scope.

Best,
Sara
Head of Strategic Accounts, Orchid Therapeutics
sara.mills@orchidtx.com

Attachment: orchid_account_brief.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Mills <sara.mills@orchidtx.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@orchidtx.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@orchidtx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff

Thanks Sara — great context. Rishi, looping in a couple of items from a Redwood enablement perspective:
- I’ll draft a guest Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and attach a filled example for Orchid — will show proposed milestones (kickoff, pilot, procurement, listing, go-to-market).
- Recommend we invite our AWS Partner Manager (we can coordinate offline) for the kickoff to accelerate co-sell qualification.
- On legal: I’ve attached a draft MAP and a short checklist of the typical marketplace procurement asks we see (SOW, MSA, billing cadence).

Suggested kickoff slots (PT):
- Wed Jul 21: 09:30–10:15 or 10:30–11:15
- Thu Jul 22: 10:00–10:45

If those work, I’ll lock a calendar invite and include a short agenda: 1) Introductions & objectives (10m) 2) Scope & usage profile (10m) 3) Procurement/legal runway (10m) 4) MAP milestones & next steps (10m) 5) AWS handoff & owners (5m).

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_template_filled.xlsx
Attachment: marketplace_procurement_checklist.pdf

-Karthik
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara.mills@orchidtx.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@orchidtx.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@orchidtx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff

Thanks all — locking Wed Jul 21, 09:30–10:15am PT. Calendar invite sent (please accept). Brief agenda below and a couple of prep items for Orchid legal/security so the meeting is efficient:

Agenda (45 min):
- 09:30 — 09:40: Intros & success criteria
- 09:40 — 09:55: Usage profile, integration points, and expected latency/throughput
- 09:55 — 10:05: Procurement & legal checklist (SOW/MSA, billing cadence, redline hotspots)
- 10:05 — 10:10: MAP milestones & owners
- 10:10 — 10:15: AWS partner handoff and next steps

Prep items for Orchid legal/security: please review the attached redlines_guidance.docx and the MAP draft (Karthik’s version). If you have preferred contract language or an MSA to share ahead of time, that will help our legal team do a quick pre-read.

I’ve also included Ava from our listing team so she can capture marketplace listing requirements and map technical dependencies.

DocuSign placeholder for NDA/SOW (if needed): https://app.docusign.com/placeholder/ORCHID-REDFLOW

See you tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_guidance.docx

From: Sara Mills <sara.mills@orchidtx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@orchidtx.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@orchidtx.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Orchid Therapeutics — AWS co-sell intake, legal preread & kickoff

Confirmed — thanks Rishi and team. Tom and Priya accepted the invite; Anika will review the redline doc and send a short compliance note after the meeting. Priya has our procurement SOW template and will share it with you by end of day.

Looking forward to a short productive kickoff.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Strategic Accounts, Orchid Therapeutics
